parameters.content:
SETUP REQUIRED
1) Put your reviews CSV in Google Drive with columns: review_id, review_date, rating, review_text, source, source_url.
2) Configure Google Drive download and CSV extraction nodes.
3) Connect an OpenAI credential and select a model.
4) Configure Google Docs + Gmail credentials.
5) Review the fee issue and sources before approval.

This importable starter keeps all external write actions behind an explicit approval form. It does not contain credentials.

APPROVED BRANCH ONLY
Add Google Docs append and Gmail Create Draft nodes here after setting credentials. Do not use Gmail Send. Map content from 'Validate Deliverables'.

values.content:
=You are a customer-review analyst for Groww, an Indian investment platform.

Analyze the reviews provided below. Use only the supplied evidence.

REVIEWS:
{{ $json.reviewsJson }}

Return a valid JSON object with these keys:

{
  "themes": [
    {
      "name": "Theme name",
      "review_count": 0,
      "evidence": "Evidence-based summary"
    }
  ],
  "top_3_themes": ["Theme 1", "Theme 2", "Theme 3"],
  "user_quotes": [
    {
      "review_id": "Exact review ID",
      "quote": "Exact verbatim quote from the review"
    }
  ],
  "fee_issue": {
    "identified": false,
    "fee_name": "",
    "evidence_review_ids": [],
    "explanation": "Explain the evidence or state that no recurring fee misunderstanding is established"
  },
  "limitations": []
}

Rules:
- Use no more than 5 themes.
- Rank themes by the number of reviews supporting them.
- Include 3 exact quotes when at least 3 usable reviews are available.
- Never invent quotes, review IDs, fees, or counts.
- Identify a recurring fee misunderstanding only if at least 3 distinct reviews directly support it.
- If no recurring fee misunderstanding is supported, set identified to false.
- Mention the small sample size and limited date coverage in limitations.
- Return JSON only. Do not use Markdown fences.

=You are preparing a weekly customer-review intelligence report for Groww, an Indian investment platform.

INPUT ANALYSIS:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.analysis) }}

Use only the supplied analysis for review findings. Do not invent statistics, customer quotes, fees, or policies.

Return one valid JSON object with exactly these fields:
{
  "weekly_pulse": "A concise report of no more than 250 words. Include the top three themes, evidence-based observations, and sample limitations.",
  "fee_explainer": {
    "applicable": false,
    "title": "Fee clarification",
    "bullets": [],
    "official_sources": [],
    "last_checked": "2026-10-11",
    "evidence_note": "Explain whether the supplied analysis establishes a recurring fee misunderstanding."
  }
}

Rules:
1. Keep weekly_pulse under 250 words.
2. If the analysis establishes a specific recurring fee misunderstanding, set applicable to true and provide no more than 6 concise bullets explaining only what the evidence supports.
3. If no recurring fee misunderstanding is established, keep applicable false and bullets empty. Do not invent a fee issue.
4. Populate official_sources with two verified, relevant official Groww URLs if you can verify them. Each entry must contain title and url. Do not fabricate URLs. If you cannot verify appropriate official sources, return an empty array and explain this in evidence_note.
5. Use the actual date 2026-10-11 for last_checked.
6. Mention that the sample contains only 8 reviews and has limited date coverage.
7. Return JSON only, without Markdown fences.

OFFICIAL SOURCES:
Always include these two supplied official Groww sources in fee_explainer.official_sources, even when no recurring fee misunderstanding is established:
1. {"title":"Groww Pricing and Charges","url":"https://groww.in/pricing"}
2. {"title":"What fees does Groww charge?","url":"https://groww.in/help/payments-%26-withdrawals/payments-charges/what-fees-does-groww-charge--58"}

Do not claim that these sources prove a customer misunderstanding. They are official references only. Keep fee_explainer.applicable false unless the supplied reviews establish a recurring fee misunderstanding. Preserve the existing JSON structure.

actionFields.text:
=
{{
  'GROWW WEEKLY PRODUCT PULSE\n\n' +
  ($('Validate Deliverables').first().json.weekly_pulse || 'Weekly pulse missing') +
  '\n\nFEE EXPLAINER\n\n' +
  (
    $('Validate Deliverables').first().json.fee_explainer?.applicable === true
      ? (
          ($('Validate Deliverables').first().json.fee_explainer.title || '') +
          '\n' +
          ($('Validate Deliverables').first().json.fee_explainer.bullets || []).join('\n')
        )
      : 'Not applicable: the supplied reviews do not establish a recurring fee misunderstanding.'
  ) +
  '\n\nOFFICIAL SOURCES\n' +
  (
    ($('Validate Deliverables').first().json.fee_explainer?.official_sources || [])
      .map(s => typeof s === 'string'
        ? s
        : (s.title || 'Official source') + ': ' + (s.url || ''))
      .join('\n') || 'No official source links were provided by the analysis step.'
  ) +
  '\n\nLast checked: ' +
  ($('Validate Deliverables').first().json.fee_explainer?.last_checked || '2026-10-11') +
  '\n\nEvidence note: ' +
  ($('Validate Deliverables').first().json.fee_explainer?.evidence_note ||
   'No recurring fee misunderstanding is established in the supplied sample.')
}}
